mintAuthority.summary: mHYPER has native issuer deployments on Ethereum and Plasma. The shared operator EOA can mint directly on both native deployments, Ethereum also authorizes its deposit-vault proxy, and the Plasma issuance-vault role is currently revoked. Monad and Katana are LayerZero bridge representations; their adapter, representation-token minter, admin, and upgrade exposures are reviewed separately in Bridge Risk. Native chain-local transparent proxies remain upgradeable through 1-of-3 Safes and two-day Midas timelocks.

upgradeability.controlRef: Midas Ethereum and Plasma native upgrade path - chain-local 1/3 Safes through 2-day timelocks

controls.label: mHYPER Ethereum and Plasma direct-minter EOA
controls.capDescription: No on-chain supply cap was identified; this role can call the token mint path directly.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25770940 and Plasma block 29982696, M_HYPER_MINT_OPERATOR_ROLE remained granted to shared operator EOA 0x5683de280d0c3967fba2f04d707fa1ef5a044e25 on both native issuance deployments. Exact-block eth_getCode returned no bytecode for the address on each chain. Its Monad and Katana representation-token powers are reviewed separately in Bridge Risk.

controls.label: mHYPER Ethereum deposit-vault minter
controls.capDescription: No on-chain supply cap was identified; each vault holds the chain-local M_HYPER_MINT_OPERATOR_ROLE.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25770940, vault proxy 0xba9fd2850965053ffab368df8aa7ed2486f11024 held M_HYPER_MINT_OPERATOR_ROLE and resolved to implementation 0xd2b5f8f1ded3d6e00965b8215b57a33c21101c63. The documented Plasma issuance vault 0xa603cf264adeb8e7f0f063c116929adac2d4286e no longer held the role at Plasma block 29982696; its revocation and default-admin re-authorization path remain recorded in the review evidence and native upgrade path rather than being treated as bridge machinery.

controls.label: Midas mHYPER Ethereum and Plasma native DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE Safes
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25527148 and Plasma block 27046783, the native-deployment MidasAccessControl granted DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE to Safe 0xb60842e9dabcd1c52e354ac30e82a97661cb7e89. Each Safe instance was 1-of-3 with the same listed EOA owners, no enabled modules, and a zero guard.

controls.label: Midas mHYPER Ethereum and Plasma native DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE EOA
controls.evidence: DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE event histories and pinned state retained EOA 0xd4195cf4df289a4748c1a7b6ddbe770e27ba1227 on the Ethereum and Plasma MidasAccessControl deployments. This authority can immediately grant or revoke M_HYPER_MINT_OPERATOR_ROLE on the native issuance deployments; representation-token administration is reviewed separately in Bridge Risk.

controls.label: Midas Ethereum and Plasma native upgrade path - chain-local 1/3 Safes through 2-day timelocks
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25770940 and Plasma block 29982696, the native token, MidasAccessControl, and issuance-vault proxies resolved through the Ethereum and Plasma chain-local ProxyAdmins. ProxyAdmin owners were timelocks 0xe3eee3e0d2398799c884a47fc40c029c8e241852 and 0xe4ccb596112d35c9862d58a113342d122cfd3c2e; each returned getMinDelay() = 172800 and assigned sole proposer/executor/canceller authority to its local 1-of-3 Safe. Monad and Katana representation-token/access-control upgrade paths are retained in route-scoped Bridge Risk controls.

review.evidence: Canonical issuance is limited to the independently listed Ethereum and Plasma mHYPER deployments. At Ethereum block 25770940, the shared operator EOA and Ethereum issuance vault held M_HYPER_MINT_OPERATOR_ROLE; at Plasma block 29982696, the shared operator still held the role while the documented Plasma issuance-vault role was revoked. DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE remains held by the shared EOA and chain-local 1-of-3 Safe authorities, so native minter grants and revocations remain immediate. The native token, access-control, and issuance-vault proxies resolve through the Ethereum and Plasma chain-local ProxyAdmins to two-day timelocks. Monad and Katana are LayerZero burn/mint representations, and their adapter, representation-token minter, admin, and upgrade facts are assessed only in bridgeRouteRisk. Economic-control evidence reviewed 2026-07-15: mHYPER is the first live Midas Attestation Engine feed; periodic NAV and reserve claims are notarized and published through Chainlink CRE, then independently verified onchain by LlamaRisk and Canary. FMA prospectus approval is not issuer prudential licensing. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-16: the native Ethereum and Plasma operator paths remain economically unbounded; existing whole-supply periodic reconciliation and independent attestation evidence remain supported.
